summary: Frontend-only regression pass on Aura 2 web preview (Expo SDK 57) at 390x844 mobile viewport. All primary asks pass: (1) Summary tab renders with the 3 glance cards (OVERHEAD, SPORTS, WEATHER) inside a plain ScrollView with functional up/down reorder arrows — clicking the down arrow on OVERHEAD moved SPORTS to the top position, and the new order persists after a full page reload (proved via AsyncStorage/aura order key). (2) Scrolling verified — Flights tab has an inner scrollable container (scrollTop reached 322px after wheel) and Device tab scrolls to reveal the footer paragraph and (after 7 taps) the Device Info card. Summary content fits entirely in a single 390x844 viewport so window/inner delta is 0 there by design — not a scroll bug. (3) Tab navigation across Summary/Device/Flights/Sports/Weather is stable — no crashes, no blank screens, no red screens across repeated switches and one reload. (4) Hidden firmware-version reveal on the Device tab works — 7 taps on the grey footer 'Aura provisions your matrix over Bluetooth...' reliably surfaces a 'Device Info' card with rows Firmware / Device / Wi-Fi IP / Signal; Firmware correctly reads 'connect to read' on web (BLE unavailable) as documented. (5) Sports copy fix confirmed — Summary sports glance shows 'Pick a team on the Sports tab', the old 'needs phone app' string is nowhere in the DOM. Following a team (NFL → Bills) on the Sports tab does NOT crash; ESPN CORS errors in console are the documented native-only limitation. (6) Weather via Open-Meteo works on web: after setting ZIP 10001 on the Flights tab the Summary weather glance shows '83°F · Clear'. (7) Persistence confirmed — ZIP (10001) and reordered card list both survive a full page reload. Only console errors are the expected CORS blocks from site.api.espn.com and api.adsb.lol, plus benign RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow* / pointerEvents (already known).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 975 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the render{Overhead,Sports,Weather} glance renderers into their own files under src/components/summary/. The GlanceCard + helpers extraction already helps, but this file keeps growing.
device.tsx is 747 lines — right at the guideline ceiling. The Hour steppers, night-mode block, and Wi-Fi form are candidates for extraction if further features land here.

moveCard() in index.tsx (lines 560-574) works correctly but reads and writes `hidden` from closure while inside setOrder. It is fine today because hidden state is stable during the swap, but future edits should stay careful to keep hidden in sync (or use useReducer).
seed_data_creation: ZIP 10001 (New York) set on Flights tab for weather + geocode; Buffalo Bills (NFL) added on Sports tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Web preview URL: https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Selectors that worked reliably in Playwright:
- Tab bar item: page.get_by_text('Summary'|'Device'|'Flights'|'Sports'|'Weather', exact=True).last.click(force=True) — .last is important because the same word appears elsewhere (e.g., 'Weather' section labels).
- Flights ZIP field: input[placeholder='28117'] (only one on the whole page).
- Weather ZIP field: input[placeholder='e.g. 33101'].
- Alert flights ident: input[placeholder='e.g. AA1234 or UAL123'].
- Reorder arrows are Ionicons SVGs without stable text/aria — the reliable approach is: find a leaf text node whose textContent is 'OVERHEAD'|'SPORTS'|'WEATHER', walk up until the enclosing pressable is >60px tall, then click at (card.left+14, card.top+card.h*0.7) for the down arrow and (card.left+14, card.top+card.h*0.3) for up. This is what proved reorder works this iteration.
- All tabs stay mounted in the DOM (Expo Router (tabs) layout), so document.body.innerText includes text from every tab; use per-locator scoped queries or getBoundingClientRect visibility (top>0 && top<viewportHeight) to disambiguate.
- CORS errors from site.api.espn.com and api.adsb.lol are expected on the web preview and must NOT be flagged.
- No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-audio, expo-video-friendly stack).
- 7-tap easter egg: page.get_by_text(/Aura provisions your matrix over Bluetooth/i) on Device tab, then click 7 times; Device Info card should appear immediately after the 7th tap.
